data.one_liner: Dart implementation of Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) using Sqlite
data.what_it_does: Implements Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) on top of SQLite for local-first data storage and synchronization. It intercepts SQL write queries to perform CRDT operations transparently and allows watching changed tables.
use_when: You need local-first offline storage with synchronization capabilities
You want to use standard SQL queries alongside conflict-free data replication
avoid_when: You only need a simple key-value store without synchronization
Your architecture does not rely on SQLite
strengths: Transparently performs CRDT magic by intercepting SQL write queries
Supports watch methods to monitor table changes for atomic sync operations
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific SQLite library setup on native and desktop platforms
Web support is experimental and requires extra setup binaries
data.setup_notes: Requires sqlite3_flutter_libs on mobile, system library packages on desktop/server, and running `dart run sqflite_common_ffi_web:setup` for web.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a standard SQLite database without CRDT synchronization features.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a reactive, type-safe SQL database library with code generation.
